\class PrecatWithSubobjClassifier \extends FinCompletePrecat { | Omega : Ob | Omega-true : Subobj Omega | Omega-univ {c : Ob} : IsEquiv {Hom c Omega} {Subobj c} (\lam h => subobjPullback h Omega-true) }
\func Omega-char {c : Ob} (s : Subobj c) : Hom c Omega
\lemma Omega-char-unique {c : Ob} {h1 h2 : Hom c Omega} (p : subobjPullback h1 Omega-true = subobjPullback h2 Omega-true) : h1 = h2
\sfunc Omega-true-map : Hom terminal Omega
\lemma Omega-true_Omega-true-map : Omega-true = inso~ (point-splitMono {_} {_} {Omega-true-map})
\sfunc Omega-pullback (m : Mono {\this}) : Pullback (Omega-char (inso~ m)) Omega-true-map m.dom m
\lemma mono-regular (m : Mono {\this}) : IsRegularMono m.f

\class PrecatWithPowerObject \extends FinCompletePrecat { | Power : Ob -> Ob | Power-belongs (a : Ob) : Subobj {\this} (Bprod a (Power a)) | Power-univ {c a : Ob} : IsEquiv {Hom c (Power a)} {Subobj {\this} (Bprod a c)} (\lam h => subobjPullback (prodMap id h) (Power-belongs a)) }
| Power : Ob -> Ob
\func Power-char {c a : Ob} (s : Subobj (Bprod a c)) : Hom c (Power a)
\lemma pullback_Power {c a : Ob} {s : Subobj (Bprod a c)} : subobjPullback (prodMap id (Power-char s)) (Power-belongs a) = s
\lemma Power_pullback {c a : Ob} {f : Hom c (Power a)} : Power-char (subobjPullback (prodMap id f) (Power-belongs a)) = f
\lemma Power-char_o {a b c : Ob} {f : Hom a b} {s : Subobj (Bprod c b)} : Power-char s ∘ f = Power-char (subobjPullback (prodMap id f) s)
\lemma Power_lift-char {a b c : Ob} {f : Hom a b} {s : Subobj (Bprod c b)} : subobjLifts (prodMap id f) s <-> (Power-char s ∘ f = Power-char subobjTop)
\lemma Power-char_top {c b a : Ob} {f : Hom c b} : Power-char subobjTop ∘ f = Power-char (subobjTop {_} {Bprod a c})
\func Power-singleton (c : Ob) : Hom c (Power c)
\lemma Power-singleton-mono {c : Ob} : Mono (Power-singleton c)
\sfunc Power-singleton-subobj (c : Ob) : Subobj (Power c)
\sfunc PHom (b c : Ob) : Equalizer (Power-char (subobjPullback psmap (Power-singleton-subobj c))) (Power-char subobjTop)
\func PHom-eval {b c : Ob} : Hom (Bprod (PHom b c) b) c
\lemma PHom-univ {a b c : Ob} : IsEquiv {Hom a (PHom b c)} {Hom (Bprod a b) c} (\lam g => PHom-eval ∘ prodMap g id)
\class ToposPrecat \extends PrecatWithSubobjClassifier, CartesianClosedPrecat, PrecatWithPowerObject
\instance SetTopos : ToposPrecat.FromSubobjClassifier (\Set u)
